label: precompute immutable pipeline tensor views
hypothesis: Repeated slicing/view creation on producer and consumer threads adds Python/ATen overhead. Precompute zero-copy source, host and GPU views during offloader construction, while performing fresh gathers every call.
expected_bottleneck: 96 instrumented buffer-view operations perprefill total0.316ms atb1 and1.089ms atb8, plus uninstrumented source/layer slices.
change: Cache tensor metadata aliases for fixed-capacity buffers/source groups; keep A0001 producer, DMA/release order, slot count and arithmetic unchanged.
tradeoffs: Extra small Python/view metadata persists for cached offloaders; backing storage unchanged.
Measured view spans include instrumentation/GIL interactions and overlap compute; model-level gain may remain unresolved.

not_run.confirmation: Only if screen promises incremental gain

decision: Exactness and fresh-data alias tests pass. Proceed to fixed12-job screen.
